findings.why: test_tune_gc_without_freeze_keeps_heap_collectable is order dependent: it asserts the default threshold (700, 10, 1000) and a zero freeze count that earlier tests change
The web tests leak gc thresholds and freeze state to later tests
The default gen0 of 700 is hardcoded and only right for python3.12; other versions differ
The default gen2 changed from 10 to 1000 and the changelog does not document it
parse_gc_config has no upper bound on gc values, so a huge value crashes after serving starts
Possible race in the watcher thread shutdown path
